hero.title: Know who reads. Follow up <hot>at the right time</hot>.
hero.lead: A quote, a deck, a resume, a sequence: send a Clozer link instead of the attachment, from Gmail, Outlook or in a campaign. See who opens it, what they read and who they forward it to. Clozer writes the follow-up and sends it when the moment is right.

silence.title: You hit send. Then, silence.
silence.body: The document is out. Did they open it? Forward it to the decision-maker? So you follow up blind: too early and you're a pest, too late and they've signed with someone else.

followUps.title: Clozer drafts the <nowrap>follow-up</nowrap>. You approve it.

brief.title: The morning brief
brief.body: An email every working day, at the hour you choose: who to follow up with and which links are about to expire.

stuck.title: A follow-up that answers what's holding them back
stuck.body: The message starts from what the prospect read and from your offer. It lands on a working day, during office hours, in the prospect's time zone.

approve.title: Approved in one click, or sent on its own
approve.body: Switch to automatic mode and simple follow-ups go out without you, like a reminder or an offer to talk.

delicate.title: Delicate cases wait for you
delicate.body: A prospect who wrote to you, a reader who came through a forward, a link never opened. Their follow-up waits for your approval, even in automatic mode.

campaigns.title: Prospect at scale. Follow up one by one.
campaigns.body: Connect your Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP mailbox, import your prospects, write the sequence. Clozer sends it from your address and changes pace as soon as a prospect reads.

sequence.title: One sequence, up to 8 steps
sequence.body: In the thread or as a new message, with a Clozer link in the step of your choice. Your CSV columns become variables.

pace.title: Your mailbox, at its own pace
pace.body: At most 30 emails a day per mailbox, ramping up over the first three weeks, during business hours in the prospect's time zone.

read.title: They read the pricing, the sequence stops
read.body: Clozer pauses the sequence, alerts you and writes the follow-up on what they read. It leaves from your mailbox, in the same thread. A reply or a bounce stops everything.

stop.title: Unsubscribe and stop list
stop.body: An unsubscribe link in every email, a stop list for the whole workspace, and results step by step.

campaigns.price: Included in Solo and Team, with a connected mailbox at €15 a month excl. VAT. <link>See pricing</link>
campaigns.smart: Keeping your sequence tool? Paste a Smart Link into it: every reader is recognized without a form, and a webhook pauses their sequence when Clozer takes over.

prospect.title: Your prospect moves forward without waiting on you.
prospect.body: It all happens inside the document. They approve, ask for a change or book a call, and you hear about it right away.

approve.title: Approve or ask for a change

book.title: Book a call

ask.title: Ask a question, or leave a voice note
ask.body: The assistant answers from your proposal and hands over to you when it doesn't know. On any page, the prospect can also leave a one-minute voice note, transcribed for you.

language.title: Read it in their language
language.body: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian or Portuguese: the PDF is translated with its layout intact.

prospect.actionsAlt: Proposal open on a phone, pricing page: at the bottom, Accept & sign, Book a meeting, Request a change, a voice note and forwarding; at the top, a choice of six languages.

trust.title: Tracking without snooping.
trust.body: Your prospects are your future customers. Heat comes from what they read, page by page.
trust.informed: The prospect is told, on the page, what you can see.
trust.discreet: Your follow-ups talk about the offer, never about what you saw.
trust.limit: Three follow-ups per contact over 30 days, max, and never right after a read.
trust.unsubscribe: An unsubscribe link in every follow-up and every campaign email, and IP addresses are never stored in the clear.
trust.europe: Hosted in Europe, encrypted in transit and at rest.
trust.private: Your PDFs have no public address: every opening is checked by our servers.

email.q: Does the prospect have to enter their email to read?
email.a: No. A link made for one prospect opens right away, with nothing to fill in. A link shared with several people, like a brochure, asks for the email so you know who's reading. With Smart Link, the address comes from your emailing tool. You can also ask for the email link by link.

informed.q: Does the prospect know their reading is tracked?
informed.a: Yes. A clear notice sits on the document page, with a link to our privacy policy. Follow-ups never mention a specific page or reading time.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Sign in with Google or your email, no password, and your prospect reads in their browser. The Gmail and Outlook extension is an optional shortcut.

tools.q: Does it work with my tools (Gmail, Outlook, CRM, outreach)?
tools.a: Gmail and Outlook on the web with the Chrome extension, desktop Outlook with the Microsoft 365 add-in, your campaigns from a connected Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP mailbox, and your lemlist, Instantly or Apollo sequences with Smart Link. For your CRM, a webhook sends every alert to the address of your choice.

cold.q: Does Clozer replace my cold email tool?
cold.a: It can. Clozer sends your sequences from your own mailbox, at most 30 emails a day per mailbox, and takes over as soon as a prospect reads. If you'd rather keep your tool, keep it: a Smart Link in its sequence is enough, and the webhook pauses the sequence at the right moment.

mailbox.q: Do I need a dedicated mailbox for campaigns?
mailbox.a: Clozer sends from the mailbox you connect, with a daily cap and a gradual ramp-up that protect its reputation. For sustained outreach, an address on a secondary domain is still the best practice. Each connected mailbox costs €15 a month excl. VAT.

auto.q: Do follow-ups go out on their own?
auto.a: By default, Clozer writes the follow-up and suggests the day and time to send it; you review it and approve in one click. Later on, you can let it send the simple ones by itself when it's confident. The tricky cases (an objection, a question from the prospect) always wait for you.

data.a: In Europe: application and documents in Paris, database in Frankfurt. Only the text of documents goes to our AI providers, in the United States, without the readers' email or IP address. The <security>Security</security> page explains how we protect it all, the <subprocessors>Subprocessors</subprocessors> page lists each provider with its country, and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> says what we collect and why.

sequence.title: The sequence
sequence.body: From Clozer, your mailbox sends the sequence with one link per prospect. From lemlist, Instantly or Apollo, a Smart Link in the sequence is enough.

read.title: The prospect reads
read.body: Clozer recognizes them. The webhook pauses their sequence: they don't get two messages.

clozer.title: The follow-through
clozer.body: What they read, a follow-up written on that topic, the meeting booked inside the document.

fair.title: Standing out after a trade show
fair.send: A two-minute video pitch, recorded that same evening, with one link per contact you met.
fair.result: You see who watched it and how far, and you call the ones who watched to the end first.

campaign.title: A cold email campaign from Clozer
campaign.send: Your prospect CSV, a three-email sequence, a Clozer link in the second one.
campaign.result: Whoever reads your pricing leaves the sequence: you're alerted, the follow-up is written, you call them.

cold.title: A sequence in lemlist, Instantly or Apollo
cold.send: One Smart Link in your sequence, whatever the tool.
cold.result: Every prospect who clicks is recognized, no form. A webhook tells your tool as soon as they read, so you can pause their sequence.

chat.title: A first conversation on LinkedIn or WhatsApp
chat.send: The link, pasted into the conversation.
chat.result: It opens on the prospect's phone, no app or account needed. You know whether they read it before you follow up.

sleeping.title: The quote that's been sitting for ten days
sleeping.send: The quote as a PDF, through a link in the client's name.
sleeping.result: You see they reread the pricing three times last night. The follow-up is ready: you read it over and send it.

decider.title: The proposal has to reach the decision-maker
decider.result: When your contact passes it on, the new reader shows up with the pages they read. You finally know who decides.

price.title: A price that needs explaining
price.send: The PDF, with a 90-second video or voice capsule on the pricing page.
price.result: The prospect hears you explain the price while reading it. You see whether they played the capsule.

abroad.title: A prospect who doesn't read your language
abroad.result: They pick one of six languages and read the translated proposal, layout included. Tracking stays the same.

web.title: A proposal built in Notion, Canva or Google Slides
web.send: The page's link, pasted into Clozer.
web.result: You know when it's opened, by whom, and how long it's read.

demo.title: A demo for people who won't take a call
demo.send: A three-minute screen recording, made in Clozer, showing the product on their use case.
demo.result: You see the parts they watched and the ones they skipped. Their questions go to the assistant, which answers from what you say in the video.

adjust.title: The prospect wants to adjust the offer
adjust.send: The proposal, with “Ask for a change” at the end of the document.
adjust.result: They write their request right there, say “Can we pay in three installments?” You're notified right away.

tech.title: Questions from their technical team
tech.send: Your technical documentation as a PDF, alongside the proposal.
tech.result: The assistant answers from the document, and hands over to you when it doesn't know.

ready.title: They're ready to move forward
ready.send: The proposal, with your Calendly or Cal.com page.
ready.result: They book a slot without leaving the document, and automatic follow-ups stop.

review.title: Spotting slipping deals before the Monday meeting
review.send: Nothing extra: each rep sends their links as usual.
review.result: The Team view shows what's moving, what's slipping, and each rep's pipeline.

vat.a: Yes, every price is excluding VAT. VAT is added depending on your country. In the European Union, with a valid VAT number, the reverse charge applies.

cancel.q: Can I stop whenever I want?
cancel.a: Yes. You cancel from the billing settings, with no commitment. Your plan stays active until the end of the period already paid, then your workspace moves to Free.

members.a: Everyone in the workspace counts, the manager too, with a minimum of 2. If you add or remove someone during a period, the amount is prorated.

coldEmail.q: How much does cold email cost?
coldEmail.a: The Solo or Team plan, plus €15 a month excl. VAT for each connected mailbox (€12 on yearly billing). A rep on their own with one mailbox pays €34 a month excl. VAT. On Enterprise, mailboxes are included.

afterTrial.q: What happens when the trial ends?
afterTrial.a: Without a subscription, your workspace moves to Free. Your links keep working and no data is deleted. Paid features unlock as soon as you pick a plan.

beta.q: I used Clozer during the beta.
beta.a: Your workspace stays on Team, for free, until a date we'll announce by email. You'll hear from us before anything changes.

invoices.a: In Clozer, under <billing>Settings › Billing</billing>. That's also where you manage your subscription and card.

payment.a: By card, through Stripe. Clozer never sees or stores your card number.

security.q: Are my documents and my customers' data safe?
security.a: Yes. Hosted in Europe, encrypted in transit and at rest, never reachable through a public address, and every workspace is isolated from the others. Details are on the <security>Security</security> page, and the <dpa>data processing agreement</dpa> is ready to sign.

pricing.final: Try Clozer on Team for 14 days.
